meta.title: Nong Nooch Tropical Garden Pattaya
meta.description: One of the world's most beautiful gardens: 1,700 rai of themed gardens, Dinosaur Valley and Thai cultural shows. Buy e-tickets online.

hero.title: Beautiful Garden
hero.subtitle: 60+ themed garden zones
hero.body: Stroll through French, Italian and tropical gardens: over 60 themed zones across 1,700 rai of world-class landscape.

promo.title: Join free and get {points} points
promo.body: Register in under two minutes with your phone number. Points for every visit; redemption opens soon.

services.title: Products and Services
services.subtitle: Everything you need for a perfect day and night at Nongnooch.

accommodation.title: Accommodations
accommodation.body: Wake up in the garden at Nongnooch Resort, Garden Villa or Pimnara Villa.

auditorium.title: Auditorium
auditorium.body: Meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions for up to 5,000 guests.

restaurant.title: Restaurant
restaurant.body: Authentic Thai flavours and international buffets with lakeside garden views.

service.title: Service
service.body: VIP cars, sightseeing bus and guided tours around every corner of the garden.

products.title: Eat, Shop & Take Home
products.subtitle: Cafés, experiences and natural products made in our garden.

cat.title: Cat Café
cat.body: Cuddle up with adorable Persian cats

coffee.title: Indra Sky Coffee
coffee.body: Sky-high coffee with a stunning view

herbal.title: Natural Herbal Products
herbal.body: Wood vinegar soap, foot spray and more

gallery.title: A world of gardens in one day
gallery.subtitle: From dinosaur valleys to French parterres, every turn is a new postcard.

news.subtitle: What's happening at Nongnooch World
news.featured: Winners announced: "Spectacular Nong Nooch World Pattaya" photo contest
news.n2: Orchid Festival returns with 3,000 new hybrids
news.n3: Night Garden light trail opens this season
news.n4: New show schedule for the Thai Cultural Show

cta.title: Become a Nongnooch member
cta.body: Sign up with your phone number and get {points} welcome points, faster ticketing and e-tickets in your pocket.
cta.p2: Thai resident prices with verified Thai ID
cta.marketing: Want news and offers? You can opt in during registration.

footer.tagline: More Than a Beautiful Garden. A World for Every Family.

footer.rights: © 2026 Nongnooch World Pattaya. All rights reserved.

auth.loginLead: Sign in with a one-time code. No password needed.
auth.registerLead: Register with your phone number and receive {points} welcome points.
auth.phoneHint: Thai numbers can start with 0. Other countries: include the country code, e.g. +86.
auth.demoHint: Demo: the code appears in the mock SMS console at
auth.secure: Your data is protected under Thailand's PDPA.

profile.title: A few details
profile.lead: Use the name on your ID card or passport. It appears on your e-tickets.
profile.thaiIdHint: 13 digits. Verified Thai ID unlocks Thai resident prices.
profile.inviteHint: From your tour guide. Adds bonus points.
profile.terms: I accept the Terms of Service
profile.pdpa: I consent to the processing of my personal data for membership (PDPA)
profile.idInvalid: This ID number is not valid. Please check the digits.
profile.passportInvalid: Passport numbers are 6–9 letters or digits.
profile.idPrivacy: We store your ID number encrypted and only ever show the last 4 digits.

done.title: Welcome to Nongnooch!
done.lead: Your membership is active. Points are collected in My Points; redemption opens soon.

checkout.title: Buy Tickets
checkout.lead: Four quick steps. Your e-ticket QR codes arrive right after payment.
checkout.passSub: Pick a single visit or unlimited visits all year.
checkout.whoSub: Thai resident prices require an account with a verified Thai ID, and each ticket names its holder.
checkout.dateSub: A day ticket is valid for one entry on the date you choose.
checkout.annualDateSub: Your annual pass starts on this date.

day.name: Day Pass Ticket
day.tag: One magical day in the garden
day.f2: Dinosaur Valley & Garden in the Sky
day.f3: One entry on your chosen date

checkout.thaiNeedsLogin: Sign in with a verified Thai ID account to get Thai prices.
checkout.thaiNeedsVerified: Thai prices need a verified Thai ID on your account.
checkout.thaiPerHolder: Thai prices apply to tickets held by you (verified Thai ID). Other holders pay the foreigner price.
checkout.freeNote: Children under 90 cm enter for free, no ticket needed.
checkout.note1: Each visitor gets their own e-ticket QR code. Scan it at the gate, no printing needed.
checkout.note2: A day ticket is valid for one entry on the selected date only.
checkout.note3: Thai resident prices are only for accounts with a verified Thai ID, with the holder named on each ticket.
checkout.summaryEmpty: Choose your tickets to see the total.
checkout.holdersLead: Each QR e-ticket shows the holder's name and the last 4 digits of their ID.
checkout.meDup: You can only hold one ticket yourself.
checkout.holdExpired: Your reservation expired. Please start again.
checkout.secureNote: Payment is processed by KBank. We never see your card number.
checkout.loginBody: Tickets are issued to your account so you can show the QR codes at the gate.

result.successLead: Your e-tickets are ready. Show each QR code at the gate.
result.issuingLong: Your tickets are still being issued. They will appear in My Tickets shortly.
result.failedLead: Your tickets are still held. You can try again.

tickets.title: My Tickets
tickets.lead: Show the QR code at the gate. One code per visitor.
tickets.brightness: Turn up your screen brightness at the gate.

points.title: My Points
points.soonBody: Use your points for tickets, food and souvenirs. We'll let you know when redemption opens.
